steps.name: An Archaeologist for Justice
steps.objective: Go to "Treasure Beach" on Marin Island and find "Keise".

steps.name: On Heaven's Behalf (1)
steps.objective: Defeat "Enraged Nagas", "Green Dragon Turtles", and "Merman Soldiers" on "Treasure Beach", then report to Keise.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Oh, you're the one...!

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: I've heard so much about you!

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: The adventurer %s, who never turns down a difficult job and makes even the toughest tasks look easy!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My name is %s, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm really not that impressive.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Anyway, what matters is that you're a capable adventurer!

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Let me introduce myself.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: I'm Keise, an archaeologist studying the ruins here on Merin Island.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: But a mad scientist called Dr. SD suddenly showed up and took over the ruins.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A mad scientist? Are SD his initials?

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Something like Sund... I don't even want to know...

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: He brought an excavation team and a whole mercenary company to occupy the ruins.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: And now they're digging everything up and damaging the site!

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: I can't forgive that.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: How dare they try to destroy these ruins...!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you want me to drive them out?

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Yes! They're trespassing and looting the place indiscriminately...

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Anyone can see they're villains!

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: And on top of that, they've drawn monsters here too!

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: If we leave them alone, this whole place will be a disaster!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. All right. I'll take care of it.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Please give them a proper thrashing!

steps.name: On Heaven's Behalf (2)
steps.objective: Defeat "Despicable Excavators", "Cruel Excavators", "Brown Bombardment Squad Snipers", and "Brown Bombardment Squad Cannoneers" in "Treasure Cave", then report to [Keise].

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: The rumors don't even do you justice.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: I've met plenty of people who were supposed to be the best, but I've never seen anyone fight like you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I suppose I've improved a little along the way...

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: You're kidding! If this is only a little improvement, what will you be like when you improve even more?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, I've cleared the area around the ruins, so I'll head inside now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If there's anything you want to tell me, now's the time.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Anything I want to tell you?

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Hmm, uhhh, well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If not, I'll just head...

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Ah! I remembered!

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Please be careful not to damage the ruins.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: There are still so many undiscovered artifacts and treasures here. One day, they'll surely help us understand this world's ancient history.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Understood?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I'll be as careful as I can.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: I'll be here, so come find me if anything goes wrong!

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: I'll help however I can!

steps.name: On Heaven's Behalf (3)
steps.objective: Defeat "KHW-8011" in "Treasure Cave", then report to [Keise].

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Dr. SD is known as a mad scientist in those circles.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Apparently, his family was killed by members of another race...

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: After that, he began pouring all his efforts into scientific research to get revenge.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So he has his own reasons.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Who in this world doesn't have a story of their own?

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Since then, he's been traveling from ruin to ruin...

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Collecting mysterious powers that science can't explain and turning them into weapons.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: They say that's how he built the bizarre machine he rides around in.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then perhaps I should just scare him off.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He hasn't committed any truly terrible crimes...

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: What are you talking about?!

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Do you have any idea how many ruins that man has damaged?!

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Do you know what a serious crime that is...

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Just because you're not an archaeologist doesn't mean you can say such careless things!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I-I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Teach him a lesson so he'll never dare come near this place again.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Understood?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Actually, that's my specialty. Hehe...

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Thank you so much.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: I know I can be a bit difficult...

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Dealing with me must have been frustrating...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad you reali...

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: What did you just say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: N-nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, it looks like everything has been sorted out...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you can focus on your research now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Contact me if anything else comes up.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Oh my, you'd help me again?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I believe in providing good follow-up service.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Hehe. I see.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Anyway, thank you for all your hard work!

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: See you again!
